magic_signatures.description: Slot 1 validity marker 0xEEEE at EEPROM block 20 (first u16)
Slot 2 validity marker 0xDDDD at EEPROM block 40 (first u16)

fields.name: slot0_magic
fields.description: Slot 0 validity marker: first u16 of EEPROM block 0, checked at load and written at init
fields.evidence: FUN_08003984 reads EEPROM block 0 via FUN_08048760 and compares the first u16 against the expected marker, and writes the marker to block 0 via FUN_08048818 on the first-time-init path. Baseline holds 0xFFFF here, which also equals the erased-EEPROM value, so the exact constant is likely rather than confirmed.

fields.name: slot0_name
fields.description: Slot 0 save name: 16 UTF-16LE characters (10 used as 'NEW GAME  ' plus 6 NUL padding in a fresh save)
fields.evidence: FUN_08003984 builds the 16-byte RAM name buffer 'NEW GAME  ' and FUN_080033d8 expands each of the 16 bytes to one LE u16 and writes 5 EEPROM blocks starting at block 1 (save bytes 8..47). Baseline save bytes 8..39 decode as UTF-16LE 'NEW GAME  ' followed by NULs.
